evidence.reason: After the edit, scheduledDelay calls reminders.reset(), then reminders.evaluate(minutes, 0.1, "benchmark"), then returns reminders.historySize(). The previous implementation called reminders.initialize() and returned reminders.evaluate(minutes, 0.1, "work") / reminders.reminderUnit. The calendar argument changed from "work" to "benchmark" and the return value changed from a delay to a history size.

The right edit adds 'if (minutes === 0) return 0;' before the existing negative-minutes RangeError check. This changes reminderDelay's behavior for minutes===0 from computing a value to returning 0 immediately, and it skips the history.splice update for that input.

The supplied test asserts evaluate(20, 0.1, "work") > 0, reminderQuote(30, 0.1, "work").amount > 0, historySize() > 0, evaluate(-1, 0.1, "work") throws RangeError, and scheduledDelay(40) > 0. It does not test scheduledDelay(0), does not test the "benchmark" calendar, and does not assert the exact return value of scheduledDelay, so the merged behavior is only partially covered.

result.userExplanation: 合并后的行为在提供的测试和调用方证据下没有被明确破坏，但左侧改动把日历参数从 "work" 改为 "benchmark" 并改变了返回值语义，右侧改动又为 minutes===0 增加了提前返回，二者交互缺乏测试覆盖，因此只能给出警告。
result.suggestedAction: 请 src/scheduling.ts 中 scheduledDelay 的作者确认是否应保留 "benchmark" 日历参数和 historySize() 返回值；若原意是保持 "work" 与延迟值，应改回 reminders.evaluate(minutes, 0.1, "work") / reminders.reminderUnit，并补充 scheduledDelay(0) 的测试以覆盖 src/reminders.ts 中 reminderDelay 新增的 minutes===0 提前返回。
